notes.title: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship – Remastered Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey Horselovers! We've got some exciting news to share with you!

In Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship – Remastered, both fans and new players can experience stunning new graphics and enhanced animations created in [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b], as well as a brand new [b]photo mode[/b] to capture Kaltenbach in all its beauty!

[previewyoutube=1Gqen1gU7OQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Main features of Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship - Remastered:[/h3]
-	Updated graphics, featuring more details to the characters you know and love
-	All animals, including Windstorm, have been updated with new animations
-	Complete World Map overhaul with new trees, plants, lighting and weather effects
-	Explore every corner of the game world to find new collectibles
-	A new photo mode to take beautiful pictures; edit and add filters to make your photos unique!
-	30 FPS support and 4K upsampling
-	Full controller support (Steam)
-	Smoother controls
-	Dynamic Lighting with Unreal’s Lumen System

[h3]New Trophies and Achievements, among them:[/h3]
-	Discover notable Places of Interest and new Hiking Trails throughout the Kaltenbach Estate
-	Fully upgrade each of Windstorm's primary Attributes
-	Recover all of Mika's lost Polaroids scattered through the region

[i]For more information about Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship – Remastered, visit our Steam page:[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2829790/Windstorm_Start_of_a_Great_Friendship__Remastered/

[i]Windstorm Links: 
[url=https://windstorm-game.com/]Official website[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/playwindstorm/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playwindstorm]TikTok[/url]
[url=https://x.com/PlayWindstorm]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/AHH4tuZ4]Discord[/url][/i]

notes.title: Windstorm - The long awaited update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/93f4463c44e08ecfa1d288026030141129906cd7.jpg[/img]

Dear Windstorm fans, 
 
since our initial release this summer, we’ve received plenty of suggestions, feedback and wishes from you; for that, and your ongoing support, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude.  

Today, we’re excited to share our first big update with you, which not only addresses technical issues, but also introduces all-new adventures with Mika and Windstorm.  

Below, you’ll find a comprehensive list of all changes made to the game. We hope you continue to enjoy exploring the lush world around Estate Kaltenbach with Mika and her best friend.  

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/0645b461925f6ae279c69f10674cd315103f1da4.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/981aacb0dc2ed71acc3c6aa787f86e0246439103.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/388d7efae36e4ba75e2dd4f91c559768f618015a.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/995be6dc786454880cabe7e3841ccab3be9799ec.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/60f1ef4e38330b047948082ad8112ace44dc0c1c.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30050665/8b84efdb2c7547983e63867eded28b34baf5c40c.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Extended mission length and improved balancing [/b]
[*][b]Added new missions[/b] to the “Free Ride” mode which can be unlocked after successfully completing story missions 
[*][b]Added difficulty settings[/b] to the options menu (Riding Beginner, Horse Lover, [*]Horse Whisperer, Nojrsodsch) 
[*]Added variable weather / time of day scenarios to missions and Free Riding 
[*][b]Controller support added [/b]
[*]New lines and voice overs for various characters, such as Tinka 
[*]General UI improvements 
[*]General bug fixes with the collision detection, world map, sound bugs and graphical optimizations  
[*][b]Improved performance on lower end hardware, such as laptops [/b]
[*]Introduced a game launcher that’s checking hardware and automatically adjusts graphical settings 
[*]The game is also now available in Polish language 
[list]
